# Hi, I'm Craig 👋

**Senior Full Stack Engineer · Claude Code · Angular · .NET · Azure 

*AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, custom skills, MCP integrations*

I've spent 25+ years building enterprise applications across finance, legal, healthcare, logistics, telecom, and e-commerce. I turn complex designs into fast, intuitive Angular front ends and back them with secure ASP.NET Core APIs on Azure. Over the past year I've made AI-assisted development, with Claude Code at the center, a first-class part of how I deliver.

### What I'm working on

- **A legal staffing and resource-planning platform** built on .NET 9, Angular 21, and Azure. I deliver features end to end, from EF Core migrations and APIs to the Angular UI and unit tests, across time off, staffing requests, assignments, and capacity planning.
- **Custom Claude Code skills** for my delivery workflow: branch-versus-main code review with severity-ranked findings, publishing those findings as anchored pull request comments, ordered manual test plans, and plans of action generated from backlog items.
- **Claude Code connected to Azure DevOps through MCP**, so the agent reads work items and publishes plans and reviews where the team already works.

### How I work

- I plan with the agent before writing code, and every change passes an AI code-review gate before a human reviewer sees it.
- I apply SOLID, DRY, and clean-code principles, and I write unit tests alongside every behavior change (xUnit, Moq, FluentAssertions, Jasmine, Karma).
- I review pull requests in detail, mentor junior developers, and translate business goals into technical solutions on Agile and Scrum teams.
